title: docs(spec): upgrade-guide entries for the flow-start-node-missing and flow-node-unreachable refusals (#32345)
body:
Fixes #32345

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:在协议 18 的升级指南里补两条语义迁移条目,一条规则一条:`flow-start-node-missing-refused`(流程顶层没有 start 节点)与 `flow-node-unreachable-refused`(有节点从 start 出发沿边走不到)。每条写明以前能存、现在拒绝什么、怎么改,以及发版前已存的行会怎样。
- 为什么改:这两条 lint 规则已经在流程的正式保存与发布时拒绝以前能存下的流程,属于收窄,但升级指南和 `os migrate meta` 里没有对应条目,升级的作者无处查。门禁放行它们,只是因为检测器读不到散文式的改法,不代表不欠条目。
- 风险与回滚:只加两个数据文件和一个 changeset,另把三份待发 changeset 的 ADR-0087 标记由 `not-required` 改为 `registered`(见 DELIBERATE CORRECTION 一节,Check Changeset 因此按设计变红、待席位确认);不动任何 schema、导出或判定;回滚即 revert。
- 先看:`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.flow-start-node-missing-refused.ts` 与 `18.flow-node-unreachable-refused.ts` 的 `reason` 字段中「Rows stored before this release」一段(这是实测读数,风险点在措辞是否与运行时一致);其次 changeset。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:spec-changes`,预期打印 `aggregate 107 converted / 568 migrated`(原为 566,多出的 2 条即本 PR)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

Two ADR-0087 D3 semantic entries, shaped like `18.picklist-binding-unknown-refused.ts`, one per runtime-gate flow narrowing:

- `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.flow-start-node-missing-refused.ts` (rule `flow-start-node-missing`). Fix: add a node with `type: 'start'` to the top-level `nodes` and an edge from it to the first step.
- `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.flow-node-unreachable-refused.ts` (rule `flow-node-unreachable`). Fix: wire the node from the start node, or delete it; a second start node is deleted.
- `.changeset/32345-flow-narrowing-semantic-entries.md`, `@objectstack/spec` patch. The entries ship in the package through the generated `registry.ts`, so this publishes.

Each entry says what used to store, what is refused now (`os validate` / `os build` / `os lint` / `os verify`, and `422 INVALID_METADATA` at the flow live save, publish and restore doors, a draft still saving and its read carrying the finding), the fix, and what happens to rows stored before the release. No `conversionIds` (no D2 conversion exists or can exist) and no `relevantWhen` (the surface includes flow rows stored in `sys_metadata`, which the stack-declares question cannot see), as in the picklist precedent.

The prefix is `18`: `PROTOCOL_VERSION` is `18.0.0` at the base, and both rule changesets (`.changeset/31224-flow-node-unreachable.md`, `.changeset/32289-flow-start-node-missing.md`) are still pending, so they ship in the next `@objectstack/lint` 18.x minor.

### The "rows stored before the release" sentences, and where each was read

<details><summary>flow-start-node-missing: kept and readable, not armed; live re-save refused</summary>

- Boot: the engine's first registration check refuses a flow with no top-level start node: `packages/services/service-automation/src/flow-registration-checks.ts:226` (in `registrationChecks`, :217-250) calls `validateStartNode` (:297-316). The boot pull and the cold-boot bind log `[Automation] failed to register flow` / `[Automation] cold-boot flow bind: failed to register flow` and go on (`packages/services/service-automation/src/plugin.ts:2537`, :5786, after the round-1 merge of `origin/main`). That engine refusal is the pending `.changeset/32142-flow-start-node-required.md`, which ships in the same release.
- Read: the stored row is served unchanged beside `registration: refused`. The real composition pins this in `packages/services/service-automation/src/flow-refused-registration-read.integration.test.ts:212-252` (kernel `running`, `getFlow` null, `status: 'active'` read back, `registration.state === 'refused'`, reason opens with the engine's words). Its save-door half (:253-272) pins the live refusal and the draft that still saves.
- Re-save: the gate charges a finding located on the written item to that write "whatever the stored row held. Re-saving a row is writing it": `packages/lint/src/runtime-gate.ts:56-58`. Drafts are never gated: `packages/metadata-protocol/src/runtime-authoring-gate.ts:32-36`, :1293.
- Escape hatch: `OS_ALLOW_UNLINTED_METADATA_WRITES=1` turns the refusal into a `console.warn`: `packages/metadata-protocol/src/runtime-authoring-gate.ts:120`, :1452-1468.
</details>

<details><summary>flow-node-unreachable: registers, arms and runs as before; live re-save refused</summary>

- Boot: no registration check judges reachability. The six checks in `registrationChecks` (`flow-registration-checks.ts:217-250`) are start node, undeclared config keys, decision modes, expressions, the api trigger secret and the after-save inline retry. `git grep -n -i unreachable -- packages/services/service-automation/src ':!*.test.ts'` names no reachability check, only a comment at `flow-registration-checks.ts:294` pointing at `os lint`. The authoring rules run only at the write doors: `evaluateRuntimeAuthoringGate` has its two call sites in `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-authoring-gate.ts:327` and :468.
- The node still never runs: `packages/lint/src/lint-flow-patterns.ts:1889-1897` ("registers, publishes, reports itself configured and never runs").
- Re-save, drafts and the hatch: the same reads as above.
- Not measured at run time: booting a stored unreachable-node flow means building the 39-package closure of `@objectstack/service-automation` in a shared container. This half is read from code, at the lines above.
</details>

## Tests

Round 0, run at head `8d48db47`, on the spec only, which has no workspace dependencies:

<details><summary>spec migrations, full spec test and typecheck</summary>

- `pnpm gen:migration-registry && pnpm exec vitest run --project local --maxWorkers=2 src/migrations` (in `packages/spec`, under the verify lock): `Test Files 5 passed (5)`, `Tests 198 passed (198)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`. Run in this form because a bare `--` before the filter is dropped by vitest.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run typecheck && pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run test` (under the lock): `registry.ts is current (568 semantic, …)`, tsc clean, `check:test-typecheck: OK`, `Test Files 836 passed (836)`, `Tests 26711 passed | 1 todo (26712)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- Chain probe (`applyMetaMigrations({ flows: [] }, 17, 18)` through tsx, scratch only): 491 todos, both new ids among them, neither in `absentTodos`. A probe from 18 to 18 gives 0 todos. So a consumer already on 18 meets these entries through the release's `spec-changes.json` `migrated` delta and the upgrade guide page, not through an `os migrate meta` hop.

No new test file. These are data entries, and the registry-integrity, acceptance-criteria and spec-changes tests in `src/migrations/` already enumerate every entry. No tested behaviour changed, so there is no ablation.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Item 2 (the gate question) is decided by the seat, not carried here.** The seat took the measured option A in claim addendum 6817391278 on #32345: a changeset declaring `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` may no longer use `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`. It is filed as #32601. This PR does not touch `scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs`.
- Contract review record 6817432684 (PASS on `8d48db47`) nit 5 stays as worded: the unreachable entry's acceptance check is a live re-save. There is no read-only check for an active row today, and the review accepted this deviation.

## Round 1 (contract review 6817432684 and claim addendum 6817391278)

What moved on head `9559d689`. It sits on a merge of `origin/main` at `e5428312`, commit `2744f6e0`, a clean merge that touches no file of this PR.

- **Finding 1 (should-fix): the restore doors.** Both entries' `surface` now name the restore doors, as the picklist precedent does: `POST /api/v1/meta/flow/NAME/rollback` and `POST /api/v1/packages/PKG/commits/COMMIT/revert`. Each "Rows stored before this release" paragraph gains a clause: a history version stored before the release that holds the shape can no longer be restored (the same 422). I read the path on the tree. `restoredBodyWriter` (`protocol-authoring-gate.ts:108-126`, the restore limb of `rollbackMetaItem` and `revertCommit` per `protocol-class-head.ts`) calls `refuseRestoredBodyTheSaveDoorRefuses`, which calls `assertRuntimeAuthoringRules` with `state: 'active'` at `protocol-authoring-gate.ts:163`. The rollback route is `POST {metaPath}/:type/:name/rollback` (`packages/rest/src/meta-item-history-routes.ts`), and the commit revert is `POST /packages/:id/commits/:commitId/revert` (`packages/runtime/src/route-ledger.ts:560`).
- **Nit 2: `os verify`.** It is named beside `os validate` / `os build` / `os lint`. `packages/cli/src/commands/verify.ts:45` imports `judgeAuthorTimeRules`, and `VERIFY_RULE_COMMAND = 'validate'` (`utils/author-time-rules.ts:89`).
- **Nit 3: the draft.** It now reads "A draft save (mode=draft) runs no rule and still stores …; the finding is on the draft read's _diagnostics", matching the pin ("with the finding on its draft read", `flow-refused-registration-read.integration.test.ts`).
- **Nit 4: the artifact case.** The start-less stored-rows paragraph now covers a start-less flow in an artifact built earlier. The boot pull registers the ObjectQL registry's flows, which `AppPlugin` fills from the manifest (`plugin.ts:2480-2483`), and warns `[Automation] failed to register flow` on a refusal (`plugin.ts:2537`).
- **Addendum 6817391278: the three rule changesets register the entries.** See the DELIBERATE CORRECTION section below.

## Round 2 (delta review 6817706509)

What moved on head `a2378032`. It sits on merge `a47e1a4a` of `origin/main` at `874166b6`, a clean merge that touches no file of this PR. Only the two entry files changed; the changesets were not touched again.

- **Finding 1 (should-fix): the automation write doors.** `18.flow-start-node-missing-refused.ts` now names `POST /api/v1/automation` and `PUT /api/v1/automation/NAME` in `surface`, and its `reason` gives their answer: `400 VALIDATION_FAILED`, with the engine's words, and nothing registered or stored. I read the path on the tree. The two routes are `packages/runtime/src/domains/automation.ts:3726` (`parts.length === 0 && m === 'POST'`) and `:4800` (`parts.length === 1 && m === 'PUT'`). Each calls `registerAndSaveFlow` (`:2528`), which runs `registerFlow` before it saves and maps the throw through `flowDefinitionRefusal` to `VALIDATION_FAILED_STATUS` (`:2552-2556`; `packages/types/src/validation-failure.ts:45` holds `400` and code `VALIDATION_FAILED`). `registerFlow` throws the first registration-check refusal as a plain `Error` (`packages/services/service-automation/src/engine.ts:5155-5157`), and `validateStartNode` comes first in that list.
- **The registration paths 32142 names.** The stored-rows paragraph now names all four with their warn lines (`packages/services/service-automation/src/plugin.ts`). The boot pull and the `kernel:ready` bind were already covered (`:2537`, `:5786`). Newly named are the `metadata:reloaded` re-sync (`[Automation] flow re-sync: failed to register flow`, `:5707`) and the metadata-change sync (`[Automation] a flow changed in the metadata store could not be registered`, `:5990`, which records the refusal).
- **Nit 2: the third restore door.** Both entries now name `POST /api/v1/packages/PKG/rollback` (`packages/runtime/src/route-ledger.ts:563`). Its handler, `rollbackToPackageCommit` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-package-commits.ts:1717`), calls `revertCommit` once per commit.
- **Nit 3: the hatch.** Both entries now read "turns the save, publish and restore refusal into a logged warning". It is the same `evaluateRuntimeAuthoringGate` exit. The start-less entry also says the hatch does not cover the automation doors' 400: that is the engine's registration check, and `automation.ts` never calls the authoring gate and never reads the variable.
- **Not changed.** `18.flow-node-unreachable-refused.ts` names no automation door. Reachability is not a registration check, so `POST /api/v1/automation` and `PUT /api/v1/automation/NAME` still register such a flow.

## DELIBERATE CORRECTION

This PR rewrites the ADR-0087 disposition marker in three pending release notes that it did not add. The two entries this PR registers made each marker false, so `check-empty-changeset` refuses them by design. ⛔ Do not restore them. The seat confirms on its own record. Only the marker line moves in each note; the line is an HTML comment and renders as nothing in a changelog. It is quoted below without its comment delimiters.

- `.changeset/31224-flow-node-unreachable.md`, line 11
  - before: `adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription) No key of any schema is added, removed or renamed: FlowSchema keeps its shape and meaning, and lint now refuses a graph whose node no edge from the start node reaches. Such a node never ran (a run starts at the start node and follows edges), so there is no rewrite that keeps what the author meant: the author wires the node in or deletes it, and the finding says which node.`
  - after: `adr-0087: registered flow-node-unreachable-refused`
- `.changeset/32289-flow-start-node-missing.md`, line 11
  - before: `adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription) No key of any schema is added, removed or renamed: FlowSchema keeps its shape and meaning, and lint now refuses a flow whose top-level nodes hold no start node. Such a flow never ran (a run begins at the start node, and the engine already refuses to register it), and no rewrite keeps what the author meant: the start node carries the trigger, which only the author knows.`
  - after: `adr-0087: registered flow-start-node-missing-refused`
- `.changeset/32142-flow-start-node-required.md`, line 11
  - before: `adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription) no key, value or spelling is retired and no stored row can be rewritten mechanically: a start node carries the flow's trigger, which only its author knows, so the refusal text names the cure and `os migrate meta --stored` lists each such row`
  - after: `adr-0087: registered flow-start-node-missing-refused`

Each new marker is spelled as `readDisposition` in `scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs` accepts it (`registered` then the id), and both ids resolve in the registry at head. `node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --base origin/main` exits 0: "this PR adds no declared-breaking changeset (4 non-breaking changeset(s) seen)". The three are breaking at base and modified, so they are skipped as inherited stock.
